title: Depth
intro: Dots near and far. The panel moves closer and further away; keep the dot sharp.

steps.text: The panel is close now. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
The panel is at arm's length and a bit. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
The panel is far now. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep looking at the dot as it comes near and goes far.
